# Urbanstrong

> Urbanstrong designs, fabricates, and installs custom preserved moss walls, living walls, green roofs, integrated solar green roofs, and smart rooftop stormwater management systems for commercial, industrial, and multifamily properties in New York City and throughout the United States and Canada. Founded in 2014. Certified Green Roof Professional, LEED AP, WELL Accredited Professional, FitWel Ambassador, Professional Engineer, OSHA Certified and SST card holder personnel on staff. Studio and workshop showroom at the Brooklyn Navy Yard, Brooklyn, NY.

Urbanstrong handles design, fabrication, and installation in-house at our workshop in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, Brooklyn, NY. Primary markets are commercial: offices, lobbies, hotels, healthcare, retail, and multifamily residential. All services are specification-grade with full documentation support for architects and owners.

## Services

### [Preserved Moss Walls](https://www.urbanstrong.com/moss-walls)
Custom preserved moss wall design, fabrication, and installation. Zero maintenance, 10+ year lifespan, Class B fire rating per ASTM E84, 8-year warranty. $120-$165/sf installed. 3-7 week lead time.
- Forty Six Fifty Luxury Rentals, 4650 Broadway, New York, NY 10040: Designed and installed a massive preserved moss wall in the lobby of a luxury rental building
- Embassy of Ireland, 1700 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20006: Designed and installed a custom moss wall map mural in the embassy elevator lobby
- Fonti Residence, 388 Morrow Rd, Englewood, NJ 07631: Designed and installed a preserved moss column wall in a high-end luxury private residence
- The Rise, 1366 E New York Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11212: Designed and installed a preserved moss wall in the lobby of an affordable housing building
- Mad Rose, 10 Grand St, Brooklyn, NY 11211: Designed and installed multiple preserved moss walls in the showroom of a luxury wine vendor

### [Living Walls](https://www.urbanstrong.com/living-walls)
Live planted wall systems with integrated irrigation and grow lighting for commercial interiors.
- The Forum at Columbia University, 601 W 125th St, New York, NY 10027: Supplied free-standing mobile living wall gardens for the lobby of a large academic building
- IFF Research & Development Complex, 1515 NJ-36, Union Beach, NJ 07735: Consulted on, designed, supplied, and project managed the installation of a 540 sf living garden wall in the lobby of a research facility
- Sui Yoga, 180 6th Ave, New York, NY 10013: Designed, installed, and maintain a living wall in the reception cafe area of a yoga studio in SoHo, NYC
- McBain Residence Hall at Columbia University, 562 W 113th St, New York, NY 10025: Designed, installed, and maintain a custom living wall garden in the lobby of a student dormitory
- Hogan Hall at Columbia University, 566 W 114th St, New York, NY 10025: Designed, installed, and maintain a custom living wall garden in the lobby of a university building

### [Integrated Solar Green Roofs](https://www.urbanstrong.com/green-roofs#integrated-solar-green-roofs)
Combined solar photovoltaic and vegetated green roof systems for NYC commercial and residential buildings. Maximizes rooftop performance and qualifies for multiple incentive programs.

### [Stormwater Management](https://urbanstrong.com/blog/smart-roof-drains-a-cost-effective-stormwater-bmp)
Smart rooftop stormwater retention systems designed to comply with local stormwater management mandates including NYC DEP requirements and reduce combined sewer overflow.

### [Green Roofs](https://www.urbanstrong.com/green-roofs)
Extensive and intensive green roof systems and rooftop amenity gardens for NYC commercial and residential buildings.
- 915 Broadway, New York, NY 10010: Design, installation, and maintenance of a rooftop amenity garden on a commercial building
- VITAL Climbing Gym, 221 N 14th St, Brooklyn, NY 11249: Design, installation, and maintenance of a rooftop amenity garden on a commercial building
- Tree of Life, 89-48 164th Street, Queens, NY 11432: Design, installation, and maintenance of a rooftop amenity garden on a commercial multifamily building

### [CEU Training](https://www.urbanstrong.com/ceu-training)
AIA, LEED/GBCI, LA-CES, IDCEC, and HSW-eligible continuing education credit approved training sessions for architects and design professionals focused on green infrastructure, green roofs, living walls, biophilic design, green wall specification, and advanced stormwater management. Available virtually or in person.

### [Rooftop Development and Energy Efficiency Consulting](https://urbanstrong.com/roof-consulting)
Rooftop development consulting for NYC co-ops, condos, and commercial building owners, covering Local Law 92/94 and 97 compliance, incentive and financing capture, and the design of green roofs, solar arrays, and amenity decks. Three consulting packages (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) range from a one-time strategy session with vendor introductions to full project and financing management.
- 3215 Netherland Ave, Bronx, NY 10463: Provided rooftop development strategy and project management for roof cavity insulation, roof membrane repair, rooftop solar installation, and EV charger planning
- Extra Space Storage, 2636 Arthur Kill Rd, Staten Island, NY 10309: Consulting, design, and procurement of rooftop solar array

### [Speaking](https://urbanstrong.com/speaking)
Alan Burchell, principal of Urbanstrong, speaks at conferences, industry events, and professional trainings on green roofs, living walls, moss walls, rooftop solar, and local laws affecting buildings. He is a professional engineer, LEED AP, Green Roof Professional, and certified CEU instructor (AIA, LEED GBCI, LA-CES, BOMI, IDCEC) whose past venues include NYC Climate Week, the United Nations, and New York City Hall. For booking inquiries, contact hello@urbanstrong.com.

### [Events, Green Displays and Rentals](https://urbanstrong.com/events-displays)
Custom greening for events and conferences. Rentals of living garden walls and preserved moss walls.
